# Apply filters for formal French cuisine and budget per person
filtered_restaurants = filter_restaurants(
    prior_results=restaurant_results,
    city="Tucson",
    cuisine=["French"],
    has_vegetarian_options=False,
    has_vegan_options=False,

    has_gluten_free_options=False,

    has_halal_options=False
)

# Save the filtered results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_restaurants", value=filtered_restaurants)

# Output the query summary
print(filtered_restaurants.query_summary)
